github-releases.fieldLicense: Repository facts; each repository's own license for its description.

evidence.finding: Section H allows API use; excessive use can suspend access, tokens can't be shared to exceed limits, no spam or sale of personal data. D.8: the terms don't restrict lawful access to public repositories' contents.

"Scraping does not refer to the collection of information through our API." Section 6 also says not to reproduce or copy "any portion of the Service"; D.8 of the terms above is what covers public repositories' contents.

"Disallow: /" for all agents. The connector uses this host for product details.

gog.note: Private cache in tuxery/source-cache as OUR precaution since 2026-11-09: GOG has not asked for this and no term we read forbids public storage; the User Agreement is unread (anti-bot page). publicStorage says what we do, not what GOG said. Undocumented API, and the cache holds full store descriptions. Earlier versions of the cache remain in this repository's git history.
gog.action: Read the User Agreement, and ask GOG. Then keep this, or move the cache back to public.
